about: Renders a set of options a person chooses one of, each a circle and its words. A press anywhere on a row checks it, and the arrow keys move between the options.

align.about: The circle's position against words that wrap: on the first line, or halfway down the words.
align.title: Alignment

choose: Choose a delivery speed to continue.
cutoff: Orders placed after 14:00 leave the next working day.

fieldset.about: A group inside a fieldset takes its name from the legend and the fieldset's invalid state. Press Continue with no option chosen: the fieldset turns invalid and shows its error text until an option is chosen. Same day is disabled, because the cut-off has passed.
fieldset.title: In a fieldset

orientation.about: `orientation="horizontal"` lays the options in a row that wraps, with the label on a line of its own. The arrow keys move along the row.
orientation.title: Orientation

palette.about: Every palette in every look. The palette fills the checked circle.
palette.title: Palettes

schedules.batched: Batch every payout into one transfer at the end of the business day, in the account's time zone
schedules.instant: Send each payout the moment it clears, with a fee of 1% on every transfer

states.about: No option chosen, one chosen, invalid, read-only and disabled. A read-only group shows its value and ignores presses.
states.title: States

status.about: Every status in every look. A status sets the edge and overrides the palette.
status.title: Statuses

title: Radio group

variant.about: Every look at every size, with one option checked so the fill shows. The dot scales with the circle.
variant.title: Looks and sizes
